scope.summary: Automatic, escalating reminders to investors who haven’t signed their subscription documents, with IR controls to pause and a log of what was sent.

assumptions: Documents are already sent and signed through the platform, so signature status is available without new integrations.
Harborlight provides logo, colours and template copy.
About 300–400 investors per closing, 3–4 closings a year.
Reminders are sent in each investor’s local business hours.
outOfScope: Routing investor replies to the right IR person (marked nice to have; can be quoted separately).

missingInfo.question: Can reminders go by SMS as well as email, or email only?
missingInfo.why: SMS adds a second delivery channel, consent rules and testing; the call left it open pending compliance.

missingInfo.question: Will IR set the reminder schedule per closing themselves, or is one default schedule enough?
missingInfo.why: A self-service schedule needs a settings screen and validation; a fixed default does not.

missingInfo.question: When only some signatories of a joint or entity investor have signed, should the others keep getting reminders?
missingInfo.why: Changes how signature status is read and who receives each reminder.

missingInfo.question: Do investors need a way to opt out of reminders, and does compliance require one?
missingInfo.why: Not discussed on the call; an opt-out needs storage, a link in every email and handling in the scheduler.

missingInfo.question: How long does your legal sign-off on email templates usually take?
missingInfo.why: Template approval sits on the path to go-live.

ask.question: Why is the range so wide?
ask.answer: The work is 286h at P50 and 339h at P80. 5 questions are still open, and each one widens the items it touches. The biggest is “Can reminders go by SMS as well as email, or email only?”: answering it narrows the range by about 17h.

ask.question: What if we add another engineer?
ask.answer: With 4 engineers instead of 3, the P50 finish moves from 2026-12-16 to 2026-12-14, and the chance of meeting 2026-12-11 goes from 34% to 44%. Total effort rises slightly, from 286h to 304h, because each extra person adds coordination time.

ask.question: Which question should I ask the client first?
ask.answer: Ask “Can reminders go by SMS as well as email, or email only?” first. It narrows the range by about 17h, more than any other open question. Next is “Will IR set the reminder schedule per closing themselves, or is one default schedule enough?” (~7h).

ask.question: How was the buffer calculated?
ask.answer: The buffer is 68h, in three parts. Task risk is 15h: the root-square of each item's P80−P50 gap. Open questions add 32h, and absence adds 21h (8% of P50 hours). Committing to ΣP50 + buffer gives 329h, landing on 2026-12-24.
